subject: SOC 2 Type II: initial evidence request, audit-period clarification & intake templates
messages:
From: Lucas Carr <lucas.carr@meta-cloud.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: security@meta-cloud.com
Date: 2025-08-01T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II artifacts and audit-window clarification

Hi Sean,

We're preparing our vendor due diligence for an upcoming procurement and would like to collect Redwood's SOC 2 Type II materials. Can you confirm whether you have a Type II report that covers the period 2024-06-01 to 2025-05-31? If not, would you be able to provide a bridge letter that explains coverage or gap remediation?

To be useful for our security review, please share the following if available:
- Final SOC 2 Type II report (redacted as needed)
- Control mapping / control matrix (mapping controls to Trust Services Criteria)
- Evidence manifest or example artifacts (log samples, change-management records)
- A brief bridge letter if the report period doesn't fully align with our requested window

Also advise on secure transfer options (S3 presigned, secure Drive share, or contact for an SFTP drop), and an estimated ETA. We're hoping to close the docs collection by Aug 7.

Thanks,
Lucas
Lucas Carr
Vendor Security Manager, Meta Cloud
lucas.carr@meta-cloud.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Carr <lucas.carr@meta-cloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-01T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II artifacts and audit-window clarification

Hi Lucas — thanks for the note and the clear list. Quick answers up front:
- We have a SOC 2 Type II report covering 2024-09-01 to 2025-08-31 (examiner date range).
- We can provide a short bridge letter that explains the audit window and confirms no material changes to controls between 2025-06-01 and 2025-08-31 if that helps cover the earlier window you requested.

What we can share now (we'll redact as needed):
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_Report_redacted.pdf (final report, PII and customer IDs redacted)
- control-matrix_redwood.csv (controls mapped to TSC categories)
- sample-logs_and_retention_manifest.txt (sanitized sample event logs and retention policy excerpt)
- bridge-letter-template.docx (template we can customize to call out audit dates and scope)

Secure transfer options:
- Preferred: single-use S3 presigned link (we can generate a link that expires in 72 hours).
- Alternate: secure Drive folder with restricted share and access audit logs.

ETA: We can assemble and upload the initial bundle by EOD Aug 3 if that timeline works. If you need a tailored bridge letter, allow one business day for our compliance team to finalize language.

Below are two short reply templates you can paste into procurement or your intake tracker — they summarize what we'll provide.

One-line: "Redwood will provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report (2024-09-01 to 2025-08-31), a control mapping, sample logs, and a bridge letter to clarify coverage; secure S3 link to follow."

Short internal: "Deliverables: redacted SOC2-II PDF, control matrix CSV, sample logs, bridge-letter draft. Upload via S3 presigned link by 2025-08-03. Contact: marissa.cole@redwood.com for artifacts; monica.patel@redwood.com for log redaction details."

I'll kick off artifact collection with Marissa and Monica now.  

—Sean Gallagher
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-01T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: SOC 2 Type II artifacts and audit-window clarification

Marissa/Monica — forwarding Lucas's ask (see attached request above). Please do the following:

Marissa:
- Prepare the redacted SOC2 PDF (remove customer names, specific ARNs, login identifiers). Filename: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_Report_redacted.pdf
- Export the control mapping as control-matrix_redwood.csv and add a short notes column for any controls with partial evidence.
- Populate a simple manifest file listing artifacts and who owns them.

Monica:
- Pull a sanitized sample of access logs (last 30 days around the audit period) and a short retention-policy excerpt. Ensure no raw IP+user combos that would identify specific customer accounts. Filename: sample-logs_and_retention_manifest.txt

Ops notes: aim to have the upload-ready bundle by COB Aug 3. We'll use a presigned S3 link (I will request the link and share with Lucas). If either of you anticipate a delay, flag me ASAP.

Also attach the bridge-letter-template.docx in the final bundle; I'll draft the language after I see the report.

Thanks — Sean

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Carr <lucas.carr@meta-cloud.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-03T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II artifacts and audit-window clarification — artifact bundle and link

Hi Lucas,

Thanks — we've assembled the requested materials and uploaded them to a secure presigned S3 bundle. The link below expires in 72 hours. If you prefer a different transfer method, tell us and we can arrange it.

S3 presigned link (expires 2025-08-06 16:40:00-07:00): https://s3.redwood-secure.example/presigned/abcd1234 (stub)

Files in the bundle:
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_Report_redacted.pdf (redactions: customer names & account identifiers)
- control-matrix_redwood.csv (control -> TSC mapping + notes column)
- sample-logs_and_retention_manifest.txt (sanitized log snippets + retention excerpt)
- bridge-letter-template.docx (draft — we'll finalize language if you confirm what you need called out)

ETA / next steps:
- Please download the bundle and let us know if you need a more detailed artifact (e.g., specific change-control tickets).
- If you need the bridge letter to explicitly reference coverage for your requested window (2024-06-01 to 2025-05-31), we can produce a short statement confirming no material control changes and providing the exact audit period we have. That will take one business day.

One-line confirmation you can paste into your tracker: "Redwood uploaded redacted SOC2-II report, control matrix, sample logs, and a bridge-letter draft via presigned S3 link on 2025-08-03."

If you need anything else, reach out directly to me or Sean.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
